name: OLYMPUS MONS — the flank

meta.citation: ESA Mars Express HRSC + NASA MGS MOLA blended global DEM, 200 m/px, v2
meta.grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 290 deg
meta.resolution_note: source product is 200 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 20 x 10 source posts and is a 50x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
meta.layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
meta.note: The largest volcano in the solar system. The flank grade is gentle and utterly relentless — 5 degrees for hundreds of km.

blurb: The largest volcano in the solar system, 22 km high and 600 km across. The flank grade is gentle and utterly relentless — the endurance case rather than the difficulty one.
